messages.subject: Wanted: examples of slow melt/cast functions
parts:
Hi all,

I'm working on a new version of reshape (reshape2) which is going to
be a honed down and accelerated version of reshape. If you have large
datasets that reshape struggles with (either because of memory or
speed, or in melt or cast), I'd really appreciate if you could send
them my way.

Thanks,
